mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalTickets, COALESCE(SUM(status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGN', 'PENDING_RESPONSE')), 0) AS pendingCount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(status = 'CLOSED'), 0) = 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at <= resolution_deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) * 100.0 / SUM(status = 'CLOSED'), 1 ) END AS slaComplianceRate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN first_response_at >= created_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, first_response_at) END ), 1), 0) AS avgResponseMinutes, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN resolved_at >= created_at THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, resolved_at) END ), 1), 0) AS avgResolutionMinutes FROM tickets
SELECT status AS groupKey, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tickets GROUP BY status ORDER BY FIELD( status, 'PENDING_ASSIGN', 'PENDING_RESPONSE', 'PROCESSING', 'RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED' ), status
SELECT CAST(priority AS CHAR) AS groupKey, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tickets GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority

SELECT trend.stat_date AS statDate, SUM(trend.created) AS created, SUM(trend.resolved) AS resolved FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS created, 0 AS resolved FROM tickets WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 13 DAY) AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(resolved_at) AS stat_date, 0 AS created, COUNT(*) AS resolved FROM tickets WHERE resolved_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 13 DAY) AND resolved_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(resolved_at) ) trend GROUP BY trend.stat_date ORDER BY trend.stat_date

SELECT t.id, t.ticket_no AS ticketNo, t.title, t.description, t.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, t.priority, t.status, t.creator_id AS creatorId, COALESCE(NULLIF(creator.real_name, ''), creator.username) AS creatorName, t.handler_id AS handlerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(handler.real_name, ''), handler.username) AS handlerName, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.assigned_at AS assignedAt, t.response_deadline AS responseDeadline, t.resolution_deadline AS resolutionDeadline, t.first_response_at AS firstResponseAt, t.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, t.closed_at AS closedAt, t.sla_status AS slaStatus, t.escalated_level AS escalatedLevel, t.remind_count AS remindCount, t.source, CAST(t.attachment_urls AS CHAR) AS attachmentUrls, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN ticket_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN users creator ON creator.id = t.creator_id LEFT JOIN users handler ON handler.id = t.handler_id WHERE t.status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 8
